situations.headline: FBR raises A$4m via discounted placement + SPP to fund Mantis/Hadrian and repay debt

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: FBR raises A$4m via discounted placement + SPP to fund Mantis/Hadrian and repay debt (interest 3, risk 7)

thesis.text: FBR remains a speculative, pre-commercial robotics developer (Hadrian bricklaying, Mantis welding) reliant on repeated dilutive capital raises to fund product validation and repay short-term debt, as evidenced by this A$4m placement/SPP priced at a steep discount [asx:c0cb1fe168843b0a44ca488542513696 p.2-3]. Value hinges on successful Factory Acceptance Testing and commercial deployment converting into recurring 'Wall as a Service' or Mantis sales; absent that, further dilution and cash-flow strain are likely.
